label: Vendor neutrality
anchor_1: Blueprint teaches protocols and patterns that transfer to any toolchain
anchor_half: Roughly half the assessed objectives are one vendor's product surface
anchor_0: Entirely one vendor's console, SDK and pricing model

label: MCP coverage
anchor_1: MCP named as an assessed objective with a stated blueprint weight
anchor_half: MCP appears in a syllabus bullet but is not separately assessed
anchor_0: No mention of MCP or any tool-protocol equivalent

label: Agent architecture
anchor_1: Agent loops, planning and termination assessed as their own domain
anchor_half: Covered inside a broader design domain

label: Sub-agent delegation
anchor_1: Multi-agent coordination assessed with named task statements
anchor_half: Mentioned as an advanced topic without assessment

label: Context management
anchor_1: Context windows, memory and state assessed explicitly
anchor_half: Touched on within a prompting domain

label: Accessibility
anchor_1: Open registration, no prerequisite, sittable from anywhere
anchor_half: Prerequisite exam or course, but no organisational gate
anchor_0: Requires partner tier or employer sponsorship

label: Cost fit
anchor_1: All-in cost well under the comfortable figure in budget.md
anchor_half: Between the comfortable figure and the ceiling

label: Time fit
anchor_1: Honest prep estimate under half the total study budget
anchor_half: Consumes most of the study budget
anchor_0: Exceeds the study budget or misses the window

label: Recognition
anchor_1: Named in job postings and tenders in the target market
anchor_half: Known within the vendor's ecosystem only
anchor_0: Effectively unknown outside its own marketing
